checks.name: runtime-version
checks.evidence: The installed OpenKnowledge CLI reported 0.68.24 and both npx fallbacks are pinned to @inkeep/open-knowledge@0.68.24.

checks.name: content-count
checks.evidence: OpenKnowledge counted 132 Markdown documents under knowledge/.

checks.name: provenance-metadata
checks.evidence: Zero stale resource paths remain; 113 source-bearing records point to /knowledge/release-information/source-provenance.md. Seventeen navigation and authority-map documents retain their original absence of sources metadata.

checks.name: navigation-links
checks.evidence: A configured-root audit exposed 244 provenance-link warnings caused by a duplicated knowledge/ prefix. The source metadata and footnote paths were corrected, and a targeted corpus scan found zero remaining old paths. The final full audit was deferred at the owner's request before private test publication.

checks.name: configured-lint
checks.evidence: OpenKnowledge lint scanned 132 documents but reported ran: []; no markdownlint, frontmatter, or OKF validator was configured.

checks.name: secret-and-personal-path-scan
checks.evidence: Literal scans found no private-key marker, API-key label, access-token label, password label, /Users/ path, Francois name, or ventervation.com value in the corpus or release administration files.

checks.name: product-material-search-exclusion
checks.evidence: Search did not return root setup/, testing/, release-information/, index.md, or the portable skill archive.

checks.name: tool-specific-path-handling
checks.evidence: With content.dir set to knowledge, search returned mental-availability-in-choice-situations as a content-root-relative path. Converting it to knowledge/mental-availability-in-choice-situations.md for exec opened the detailed record successfully. The skill and setup guidance now document this tool-specific conversion.

checks.name: runtime-search-boundary
checks.evidence: Unfiltered local OpenKnowledge search can return runtime-generated skill pages. The portable skill resolves content.dir, rejects results outside the corpus, and converts search paths for the selected read tool. The separately supplied hosted gateway was not rebuilt or remotely retested in this release pass.

checks.name: direct-read-boundary
checks.evidence: The local OpenKnowledge exec surface is not confined to knowledge/. Do not publish unrestricted exec. The remote gateway must expose path-constrained read operations only.

checks.name: portable-skill
checks.evidence: OpenKnowledge accepted the managed skill with valid metadata. The packaged skill resolves the corpus root, handles differing search and exec path namespaces, restricts each turn to 5-10 search results and 2-4 detailed records with one retry, uses read-only retrieval, separates facts from inference, identifies missing information, and asks one focused question.

checks.name: skill-archive-integrity
checks.evidence: unzip -t reported no errors; the archive contains one 4,654-byte SKILL.md.

release_decision: The package is suitable for private repository publication and controlled agent testing. Remote end-to-end testing and the deferred final full audit remain outstanding. It is not approved for unrestricted public MCP exposure.
